description: This file contains utility functions and helpers for setting up transport-specific FastAPI routes, handling WebRTC/WebSocket connections, SDP manipulation, and transport detection for a telephony/video application. It includes functions for parsing WebSocket messages, creating transport instances, and cleaning SDP data for WebRTC compatibility.

methods.name: _detect_transport_type_from_message
methods.description: Attempts to auto-detect the transport type based on WebSocket message structure by inspecting message fields for known provider patterns.

methods.name: parse_telephony_websocket
methods.description: Reads and parses initial WebSocket messages to determine the telephony provider type and extract provider-specific call data.

methods.name: get_transport_client_id
methods.description: Retrieves a transport-specific client identifier from a client object, supporting SmallWebRTC and Daily transports.

methods.name: maybe_capture_participant_camera
methods.description: Triggers video capture of participant's camera if the transport supports it.

methods.name: maybe_capture_participant_screen
methods.description: Triggers screen video capture for a participant if supported by the transport.

methods.name: _smallwebrtc_sdp_cleanup_ice_candidates
methods.description: Removes unsupported ICE candidates from SDP text based on a pattern.

methods.name: _smallwebrtc_sdp_cleanup_fingerprints
methods.description: Removes unsupported fingerprint algorithms (sha-384, sha-512) from SDP text.

methods.name: smallwebrtc_sdp_munging
methods.description: Applies SDP modifications for SmallWebRTC, including fingerprint and ICE candidate cleanup.

methods.name: _get_transport_params
methods.description: Retrieves transport parameters from a factory function based on a transport key.

methods.name: _create_telephony_transport
methods.description: Creates and configures a telephony transport instance with provider-specific call data and serializer.

methods.name: create_transport
methods.description: Main factory function to create a transport instance based on runner arguments and transport parameters, supporting daily, webrtc, and telephony providers.
